items.title: 67260_Freddie Moore oral history interview
items.q: The transcript discusses 'Pops Foster' (Edmond Hall's bassist, often called Pops Foster, distinct from Louis Armstrong who is also sometimes called Pops, but the context clearly refers to the bassist Pops Foster). The name 'Louis Armstrong' does not appear in the text. The interviewer asks about 'Po

ctx.x: How about Pops Foster? How did you get along with Pops?

Oh, me and Pops was all right together. Because Pops was a bit older than I was, and Pops used to slap his bass a whole lot, you know. And sometimes they'd get a little fast, so I'd hold him... I liked the way he swung with the bass.
He and Sidney Bechet was... They were both from New Orleans. Pops Foster was from New Orleans.
